text: No field on my menu separates this trend from the deal price. `elder` 7.0 is a fresh green-to-blue drop (C4), and a blended score cannot say whether a merger spread or buyers moved it (C2). `mp` 97.0 with `mp_state` FADING reads persistence, not cause. My card applies the EVENT-DRIVEN exclusion, so I cannot support WTRG on an H1 close above Friday's high. I stay aside (C22). What would clear it: a field showing price moving off the deal level, then a dip to 6 or lower and a reclaim to 7+ near ma_20.
